text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Not yet! Don't let your guard down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだよ！
油断すんな！

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: Please stop, Yamato-sama! There's no more fighting...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もうおやめください、
ヤマト様！
これ以上の争いは……！

text_block_list.name: Quria
text_block_list.text: I'm worried about your health, but... It's not like you guys! You're just following someone's orders and putting your life on the line...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
身体も心配ですけど……
ヤマトさんたちらしくないですよ！
誰かの言いなりになって、
体を張るだなんて……！

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: Tch! You're acting like you know what I'm talking about! It's really annoying...! In the first place...
text_block_list.orig_text:
チッ！
わかったようなコト言いやがって、
シャクに障るね……！
そもそも──

text_block_list.name: Yamato
text_block_list.text: There's no way that's enough to stop me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この程度で参るワケ、
ないだろうがっ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: That's right! Don't make fun of me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーそー！
バカにすんのもいーかげんにしろっつーの！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！
まだ、
これほどの力が……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Maybe their anger is turning into power...? But I won’t lose to something like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
怒りが、
力に変わってるのかも……？
でも、
そんなものに負けませんよ！

text_block_list.name: Wakana
text_block_list.text: A-Are you still going to do it? I knew it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
まだやるの？
やっぱり……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
This time──
Let's surpass the weakling brother and become a fry brother!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度こそ──
ザコお兄さん通り越して、
稚魚お兄さんになっちゃえ～っ！
